population_provenance: n_true and pre-truth harm IDs are from existing W1b nominal h=30 T_int rows (actual rounded coordinates recorded per regime). PL truth uses exactly h=30 T_int. Scoring recomputes its exact-grid n_true and reports any membership difference; never substitutes the rounded row for an exact-grid outcome.

implementation.seed_index: zero-based sorted matched-regime id (excluded case removed)
implementation.history: observations at 0..floor(L/delta); all overlapping lag-10 pairs in each prefix
implementation.sampling: untruncated uniformization, exactly exp(Q*delta), original finite-N generator
implementation.estimator: mode-matched equal-weight k=50 including all equal-distance boundary pairs
implementation.fallback: fewer than k: mean of all same-mode pairs; no same-mode pairs: mean of all pairs
implementation.ties: strict <0 -> Switch, otherwise Stay; no decision epsilon
implementation.fresh_rule: unchanged exact current fluid gap on both telemetry sides; only stale learns
implementation.both_side: max(fresh regret, stale regret), relative to fresh true-model oracle C_ref
implementation.T4_zero_rate: saturated fluid gap at h_bar, old fluid posterior at the true requested tau
implementation.T4_long_h: existing Chain.V gain-bias formula; bounded negligible tail omission, no direct huge-h exponential

forecasts.F2: Switch-optimal harm persists at all L
forecasts.F3: Stay-optimal harm lost more often at small L
